subject: facet_grid reverse on y axis compared to coord_flip

messages.author: 823dbccdc15c7f4a
messages.subject: facet_grid reverse on y axis compared to coord_flip
parts:
Hi,

facet_grid somehow produces an ordering of factors on the y axis which is the opposite of what you get with coord_flip (at least for barplots).

library("ggplot2")
library("gridExtra")

df <- data.frame(value=rnorm(1:300),labels=c("A","B","C"))
dens <- ggplot(df, aes(fill=labels,x=value)) + geom_density() + facet_grid(labels ~ .)
bar <- ggplot(df, aes(fill=labels, x=labels)) + geom_bar(stat="bin") + coord_flip()
grid.arrange(bar, dens, nrow=1)

I manage to resort the bar plot with:
grid.arrange(bar + scale_x_discrete(limits = rev(levels(df$labels))), dens, nrow=1)

but this level reversing stuff feels error prone. I actually reordered some data not correctly until I managed it this way.
Is there an easier way?

thank you very much,
ido
